parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family inet address 10.1.4.2/24
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
